generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

Work Experience- The intending bidder shall have successfully executed at least one work order during any of the preceding five financial years (FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26), as a contractor, for the Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning (SITC) of Hi-wall Split ACs/Cassette ACs/Packaged ACs/Chiller Units or Comprehensive Maintenance of Hi-wall Split ACs/Cassette ACs/Packaged ACs/Chiller Units in any Government, Public Sector or Private Organization, having a single work order value of not less than Rs.2.77 lakh as on the last date of bid submission.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The bidder shall upload the Work Completion Certificate,Work Done Certificate, issued by the competent authority, as proof of experience.

technicalCriterionList.description: Annual Turnover- The intending bidder should have an annual turnover of not less than Rs.5.6 Lakhs in any two (2) financial years of the preceding five financial years i.e., from FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload Audited Profit & Loss account statements/Turn over certificate duly certified by chartered Accountant.

technicalCriterionList.description: Statutory- The bidder should have statutory registration such as registration of establishments/firm/company, GST Registration Certificate, PF, PAN and furnish Certificates along with technical bid. On demand Original shall be produced for verification.
